verdict.rationale: Fly.io is an app-hosting platform, so collaborative commenting on preview and production deployments is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any commenting, feedback, or review-overlay feature on deployed environments. The docs cover deploys, Machines, Sprites, HTTPS URLs and access grants, none of which provide in-environment comments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
